# Disk Status v1.10.0

First publication-ready release of Disk Status for Omarchy.

## Highlights

- Compact popup dashboard and space-efficient pinned sidebar
- Worst-drive status headline with removable drives excluded from the score
- SMART status, temperature, capacity, live I/O, and expandable diagnostics
- Theme-aware QML interface using Omarchy semantic colors
- Hardened, low-overhead collector that avoids waking sleeping disks
- Redacted reports and support bundles for safer issue reporting

## Install

```bash
omarchy plugin add https://github.com/denizkin28/omarchy-disk-status
cd ~/.config/omarchy/plugins/denizkin.disk-status
./install.sh
```

See the [README](../../README.md) for requirements, configuration, screenshots, and usage. Review [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) before sharing diagnostics.
